tasks.name: Reach a target pose
tasks.description: Move the Stretch 2 gripper-slider body to a specified tabletop target position without manipulating an object.
tasks.applicability: Hello Robot Stretch 2 is a free-base mobile manipulator with a lift, coupled telescoping arm, wrist yaw, and gripper slide; its base can position the robot and its gripper-slider body can perform a point-to-point tabletop reach.
tasks.adaptation: Replace the Sawyer body and benchmark scene with the canonical local Stretch 2 MJCF model and a private target body. Preserve the source Euclidean position metric, metre unit, comparator, and 0.05 m threshold; use the public gripper-slider body because this model has no source end-effector site.
scene_assumptions: A fixed target body is placed in the reachable workspace after base positioning.
The private scene leaves collision-free free space for the gripper-slider body.
observation_assumptions: The observation exposes link_gripper_slider position and target position in the world metre frame.
The private binding evaluates terminal Euclidean position error.
